This plotting notebook reads the phylogenetically validated V18 AMF object from
the corrected LSU analysis. It does not rerun denoising or phylogenetic placement.
Each bar is one independent biological sample. Its denominator is the number of
**validated AMF LSU reads in that sample**, not all LSU reads and not organism
biomass. A sample without validated AMF reads is shown as an empty outlined bar
marked `ND` (not detected), never as a 100% composition bar. Read counts are
printed above every bar because several positive samples have very few reads.

The six family colors are kept constant across hosts. The V18 label
`Sclerocystaceae_Kamienskiaceae` is an unresolved combined clade, not a single
named family. There were no LSU negative controls; interpret low-read patterns
descriptively.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
required <- c("phyloseq", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "ggplot2", "scales")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Install missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

# Paths


# Validate and prepare counts

```{r data}
ps_amf_all <- readRDS(amf_rds)
if (!inherits(ps_amf_all, "phyloseq")) stop("Expected a phyloseq object.")

otu <- as(otu_table(ps_amf_all), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_amf_all)) otu <- t(otu)
metadata <- as(sample_data(ps_amf_all), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID_join")
taxonomy <- as(tax_table(ps_amf_all), "matrix")

if (!setequal(rownames(otu), metadata$SampleID_join) ||
    !setequal(colnames(otu), rownames(taxonomy))) {
  stop("Sample or ASV identifiers do not match across count, metadata, and taxonomy tables.")
}
if (!all(c("Host_species", "Compartment", "Plant_replicate") %in% names(metadata))) {
  stop("Required host, compartment, or replicate metadata is missing.")
}
if (anyNA(otu) || any(otu < 0) || any(otu != round(otu))) {
  stop("ASV table must contain non-negative integer counts with no missing values.")
}

family <- taxonomy[colnames(otu), "Family"]
family[is.na(family) | family == ""] <- "Unclassified_Glomeromycota"
family_counts <- t(rowsum(t(otu), group = family, reorder = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(unname(rowSums(family_counts)), unname(rowSums(otu))))

family_colors <- c(
  "Acaulosporaceae" = "#E5D78B",
  "Ambisporaceae" = "#4F8DA8",
  "Archaeosporaceae" = "#A64924",
  "Glomeraceae" = "#68C34A",
  "Sclerocystaceae_Kamienskiaceae" = "#B7DDF0",
  "Unclassified_Glomeromycota" = "#B5B5B5"
)
if (!all(colnames(family_counts) %in% names(family_colors))) {
  stop("New V18 family/clade label found; review the palette before plotting: ",
       paste(setdiff(colnames(family_counts), names(family_colors)), collapse = ", "))
}

part_order <- c("BR", "BS", "SP", "Rh", "root", "stolon", "BG", "AG", "leaf")
part_names <- c(
  BR = "BR", BS = "BS", SP = "SP", Rh = "Rhizosphere",
  root = "Root endosphere", stolon = "Stolon endosphere",
  BG = "BG", AG = "AG", leaf = "Leaf endosphere"
)
if (!all(as.character(metadata$Compartment) %in% part_order)) {
  stop("Unrecognized compartment; update part_order and part_names before plotting.")
}

sample_depth <- metadata %>%
  transmute(
    SampleID_join,
    Host_species = as.character(Host_species),
    Compartment = factor(as.character(Compartment), levels = part_order),
    Plant_replicate = as.character(Plant_replicate),
    AMF_reads = unname(rowSums(family_counts)[SampleID_join])
  ) %>%
  arrange(Host_species, Compartment, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Plant_replicate)),
          Plant_replicate, SampleID_join)

if (anyNA(sample_depth$AMF_reads) || anyNA(sample_depth$Compartment)) {
  stop("AMF depth or compartment could not be matched for every sample.")
}

family_long <- as.data.frame(family_counts) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID_join") %>%
  pivot_longer(-SampleID_join, names_to = "Family", values_to = "Family_reads") %>%
  left_join(sample_depth, by = "SampleID_join", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_abundance = if_else(AMF_reads > 0, Family_reads / AMF_reads, NA_real_),
    Family = factor(Family, levels = names(family_colors))
  )

if (anyNA(family_long$Family) ||
    any(abs(rowSums(family_counts) - sample_depth$AMF_reads[
      match(rownames(family_counts), sample_depth$SampleID_join)]) > 0)) {
  stop("Family counts did not reconcile with sample totals.")
}

write.csv(
  family_long %>% select(SampleID_join, Host_species, Compartment,
                         Plant_replicate, AMF_reads, Family, Family_reads,
                         Relative_abundance),
  file.path(plot_dir, "LSU_AMF_per_host_family_relative_abundance.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

sample_depth %>%
  group_by(Host_species, Compartment) %>%
  summarise(samples = n(), AMF_positive = sum(AMF_reads > 0),
            min_positive_reads = if (any(AMF_reads > 0)) min(AMF_reads[AMF_reads > 0])
                                 else NA_real_, .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "AMF detections by host and compartment")
```

# All-LSU composition: validated AMF families plus reads not validated as AMF

```{r}
all_lsu_file <- file.path(out_path, "seqtab_nochim_ASV_IDs.rds")

if (!file.exists(all_lsu_file)) {
  stop("Missing full LSU ASV table: ", all_lsu_file)
}

all_lsu_counts <- readRDS(all_lsu_file)

if (!is.matrix(all_lsu_counts)) {
  all_lsu_counts <- as.matrix(all_lsu_counts)
}

if (!setequal(rownames(all_lsu_counts), sample_depth$SampleID_join)) {
  stop("The complete LSU count table and AMF metadata contain different samples.")
}

# Reorder to match the metadata used in the plotting notebook
all_lsu_counts <- all_lsu_counts[
  sample_depth$SampleID_join,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Build a complete sample × validated-family count matrix.
# Families absent from a sample or host remain zero.
validated_family_counts <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = nrow(all_lsu_counts),
  ncol = length(family_colors),
  dimnames = list(
    rownames(all_lsu_counts),
    names(family_colors)
  )
)

shared_families <- intersect(
  colnames(family_counts),
  names(family_colors)
)

validated_family_counts[
  rownames(family_counts),
  shared_families
] <- family_counts[, shared_families, drop = FALSE]

# Denominators and residual reads
total_lsu_reads <- rowSums(all_lsu_counts)
validated_amf_reads <- rowSums(validated_family_counts)
not_validated_reads <- total_lsu_reads - validated_amf_reads

if (any(total_lsu_reads <= 0)) {
  stop("At least one sample contains no non-chimeric LSU reads.")
}

if (any(not_validated_reads < 0)) {
  stop("Validated AMF reads exceed total LSU reads in at least one sample.")
}

not_validated_label <- "LSU reads not validated as AMF"

composition_counts <- cbind(
  validated_family_counts,
  setNames(
    data.frame(not_validated_reads),
    not_validated_label
  )
)

# Every bar must reconcile exactly to its full LSU library
stopifnot(
  all(rowSums(composition_counts) == total_lsu_reads)
)

all_lsu_depth <- sample_depth %>%
  mutate(
    Total_LSU_reads =
      unname(total_lsu_reads[SampleID_join]),

    Validated_AMF_reads =
      unname(validated_amf_reads[SampleID_join]),

    Validated_AMF_fraction =
      Validated_AMF_reads / Total_LSU_reads
  )

all_lsu_long <- as.data.frame(
  composition_counts,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID_join") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -SampleID_join,
    names_to = "Read_category",
    values_to = "Reads"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    all_lsu_depth,
    by = "SampleID_join",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_abundance = Reads / Total_LSU_reads,
    Percent_all_LSU = 100 * Relative_abundance,

    # Places the validated-family portions together at the base
    # of each stacked bar.
    Read_category = factor(
      Read_category,
      levels = c(
        not_validated_label,
        names(family_colors)
      )
    )
  )

# Export the exact percentage represented by every family in every sample
write.csv(
  all_lsu_long %>%
    select(
      SampleID_join,
      Host_species,
      Compartment,
      Plant_replicate,
      Total_LSU_reads,
      Validated_AMF_reads,
      Validated_AMF_fraction,
      Read_category,
      Reads,
      Relative_abundance,
      Percent_all_LSU
    ),
  file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "LSU_all_reads_family_relative_abundance.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Keep the existing family colors.
# Use a lighter grey than Unclassified_Glomeromycota for the residual reads.
all_lsu_colors <- c(
  family_colors,
  setNames("#E8E8E8", not_validated_label)
)

# Retain enough decimal places to report very small read fractions
format_tiny_percent <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    x == 0,
    "0.000%",
    ifelse(
      x < 0.00001,
      "<0.001%",
      scales::percent(x, accuracy = 0.001)
    )
  )
}

plot_host_all_lsu <- function(host) {

  host_depth <- all_lsu_depth %>%
    filter(Host_species == host) %>%
    mutate(
      Sample_x = factor(
        SampleID_join,
        levels = SampleID_join
      ),

      # Sample-specific annotation shown above each bar
      AMF_label = if_else(
        Validated_AMF_reads == 0,
        "AMF ND\n0 reads",
        paste0(
          "AMF ",
          format_tiny_percent(Validated_AMF_fraction),
          "\n",
          Validated_AMF_reads,
          " reads"
        )
      )
    )

  host_long <- all_lsu_long %>%
    filter(
      Host_species == host,
      Reads > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Sample_x = factor(
        SampleID_join,
        levels = levels(host_depth$Sample_x)
      )
    )

  # Calculate host-pooled percentages for the legend
  host_total <- sum(host_depth$Total_LSU_reads)

  host_family_reads <- colSums(
    validated_family_counts[
      host_depth$SampleID_join,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )

  host_not_validated <-
    host_total - sum(host_family_reads)

  legend_breaks <- c(
    names(family_colors),
    not_validated_label
  )

  legend_fraction <- c(
    host_family_reads,
    host_not_validated
  ) / host_total

  legend_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(
      legend_breaks,
      " (",
      format_tiny_percent(legend_fraction),
      ")"
    ),
    legend_breaks
  )

  rep_labels <- setNames(
    paste0("R", host_depth$Plant_replicate),
    host_depth$SampleID_join
  )

  ggplot(
    host_long,
    aes(
      x = Sample_x,
      y = Relative_abundance,
      fill = Read_category
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.86,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.15
    ) +

    # Total validated-AMF percentage and count for each sample
    geom_text(
      data = host_depth,
      aes(
        x = Sample_x,
        y = 1.025,
        label = AMF_label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.6,
      lineheight = 0.95
    ) +

    facet_grid(
      . ~ Compartment,
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x",
      labeller = as_labeller(part_names)
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = all_lsu_colors,
      breaks = legend_breaks,
      labels = legend_labels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = paste0(
        "Read category\n",
        "(host-pooled % of all LSU reads)"
      )
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = function(x) unname(rep_labels[x])
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1.11),
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste("LSU -", host),
      x = "Independent biological sample (replicate)",
      y = "Relative abundance among all non-chimeric LSU reads",
      caption = paste(
        "Grey = LSU reads not validated as AMF by the V18 workflow.",
        "Labels above bars give each sample's total validated-AMF percentage and read count.",
        "Legend percentages pool all samples of the displayed host;",
        "read fractions do not represent organism abundance."
      )
    ) +

    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        colour = "#A6192E",
        size = 14
      ),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey92",
        colour = "grey45"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 7.5,
        hjust = 0
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

# Export one PDF for every host
hosts <- sort(unique(all_lsu_depth$Host_species))

for (host in hosts) {

  n_parts <- n_distinct(
    all_lsu_depth$Compartment[
      all_lsu_depth$Host_species == host
    ]
  )

  width <- max(
    9,
    5.5 + 1.1 * n_parts
  )

  file <- file.path(
    plot_dir,
    paste0(
      "LSU_all_reads_family_relative_abundance_",
      host,
      ".pdf"
    )
  )

  ggsave(
    file,
    plot_host_all_lsu(host),
    width = width,
    height = 4.8,
    units = "in",
    device = grDevices::pdf,
    useDingbats = FALSE
  )

  if (!file.exists(file) || file.info(file)$size == 0) {
    stop("PDF export failed: ", file)
  }

  cat("Wrote:", file, "\n")
}
```

# Per-host figure panels

```{r per-host-plots, fig.keep='none'}
plot_host <- function(host) {
  host_depth <- sample_depth %>%
    filter(Host_species == host) %>%
    mutate(Sample_x = factor(SampleID_join, levels = SampleID_join))
  host_long <- family_long %>%
    filter(Host_species == host) %>%
    mutate(Sample_x = factor(SampleID_join, levels = levels(host_depth$Sample_x)))

  # Deliberately preserve the sample slot for AMF-negative libraries.
  zeros <- host_depth %>% filter(AMF_reads == 0)
  positives <- host_long %>% filter(AMF_reads > 0, Family_reads > 0)
  rep_labels <- setNames(paste0("R", host_depth$Plant_replicate),
                         host_depth$SampleID_join)

  ggplot() +
    geom_blank(data = host_depth, aes(x = Sample_x, y = 0)) +
    geom_col(data = zeros,
             aes(x = Sample_x, y = 1), width = 0.86,
             fill = "white", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_col(data = positives,
             aes(x = Sample_x, y = Relative_abundance, fill = Family),
             width = 0.86, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(data = zeros, aes(x = Sample_x, y = 0.50, label = "ND"),
              colour = "grey35", size = 3.3) +
    geom_text(data = host_depth,
              aes(x = Sample_x, y = 1.045, label = AMF_reads),
              size = 2.9) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Compartment, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
               labeller = as_labeller(part_names)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = family_colors, breaks = names(family_colors),
                      drop = FALSE, name = "V18 AMF family/clade") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) unname(rep_labels[x])) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                       labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.10), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste("LSU -", host),
      x = "Independent biological sample (replicate)",
      y = "Share of validated AMF reads",
      caption = paste(
        "Numbers above bars = validated AMF reads; ND = not detected.",
        "Only AMF-positive samples have a defined within-AMF composition."
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#A6192E", size = 14),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = "grey45"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

hosts <- sort(unique(sample_depth$Host_species))
for (host in hosts) {
  n_parts <- n_distinct(sample_depth$Compartment[sample_depth$Host_species == host])
  width <- max(7.5, 4.2 + 1.1 * n_parts)
  file <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0("LSU_AMF_family_relative_abundance_", host, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(file, plot_host(host), width = width, height = 4.3,
         units = "in", device = grDevices::pdf, useDingbats = FALSE)
  if (!file.exists(file) || file.info(file)$size == 0) {
    stop("PDF export failed: ", file)
  }
  cat("Wrote:", file, "\n")
}
```

These PDFs are deliberately separate from the 16S and ITS panels. Their
families, colors, and read denominator differ from the earlier LSU figure
drafts. To integrate one into a multi-amplicon figure, retain its read-count
labels and its `ND` samples, and use this notebook's V18 legend rather than
the previous LSU legend.
